highlights.title: Two Nex reasoning models
highlights.text: Try paid-only `nex-agi/nex-n2.5-pro` and `nex-agi/nex-n2.5-mini` with text or image input. Pro also supports tool calling. [Explore text models](https://gen.pollinations.ai/v1/models).

highlights.title: Mistral Large 4 added
highlights.text: Use paid-only Mistral Large 4 for text and image input, reasoning, and tool calling. [Explore text models](https://gen.pollinations.ai/v1/models).

highlights.title: More video reference options
highlights.text: Pass image, video, or audio reference URLs to video generation through the SDK, including arrays of URLs. [Explore the SDK](https://www.npmjs.com/package/@pollinations/sdk).

highlights.title: SoloForge AI joins the catalog
highlights.text: Turn content ideas into generated assets, review them, and organize publishing workflows with Pollinations image generation. [Try it](https://soloforge-ai-web.onrender.com).

highlights.title: Audio joins the catalog
highlights.text: Try this community text-to-speech app; its BYOP access requires sign-in. [Try it](https://dwikatmahmoud87-source.github.io/Gtdcg).

highlights.title: Eleven v4 speech arrives
highlights.text: Generate speech with `elevenlabs/eleven-v4` or the faster `elevenlabs/eleven-v4-turbo`, including word timestamps. [Try the audio API](https://gen.pollinations.ai/docs).

highlights.title: Nano Banana 2.1
highlights.text: Create images at 1K or 2K, or edit them using up to 14 reference images with `google/gemini-nano-banana-2.1`. [See image models](https://gen.pollinations.ai/image/models).

highlights.title: Grok Imagine Video 1.5 Lite
highlights.text: Turn a prompt or starting image into a 1–15 second clip at up to 1080p. [Explore the API](https://gen.pollinations.ai/docs).

highlights.title: API keys get model categories
highlights.text: Give a key access to text, image, audio, video, or other categories instead of selecting models one by one; new models in that category are included automatically. [Manage keys](https://enter.pollinations.ai/keys).

highlights.title: FLUX.3 Image arrives
highlights.text: Generate 1K or 2K images in fifteen aspect ratios, or edit with up to ten reference images. [Explore image models](https://gen.pollinations.ai/image/models).

highlights.title: Seedream 5.0 Flash joins the garden
highlights.text: Generate and edit images with up to ten references, seed control, and 1K or 2K output. [Explore image models](https://gen.pollinations.ai/image/models).

highlights.title: Ling 3.1 Flash is here
highlights.text: Try a new text model with reasoning, tool use, and a 262K-token context at zero launch pricing, including with Quest Pollen. [See text models](https://gen.pollinations.ai/v1/models).

highlights.title: Decisions get another model
highlights.text: Liquid D1 is available for paid decision requests and chat; the [SDK](https://www.npmjs.com/package/@pollinations/sdk) now has a typed `decision()` call for Jev.

highlights.title: Find the model you meant
highlights.text: Search and filter the model catalog by capabilities through the API or MCP; Open WebUI can now sort models by category tags. [API docs](https://gen.pollinations.ai/docs).

highlights.title: Seven quests, one page
highlights.text: Pollinations Quest Starter walks new users through setup without sending their API key to its server. [Try it](https://elite-surely-machine-enemies.trycloudflare.com)

highlights.title: New Quests for video and community models
highlights.text: Earn Pollen for trying a video or community model; model publishers can earn it when others use their models.

highlights.title: Claude Code connects directly
highlights.text: Polli CLI can connect Claude Code to Pollinations’ `/v1/messages` endpoint, with model aliases and a separate config that leaves your Claude settings alone. [Get Polli CLI](https://www.npmjs.com/package/@pollinations/cli).

highlights.title: Explore a painted world
highlights.text: In Postcard Worlds, enter a place, then step through doors and paths in AI-painted scenes that carry the view forward. [Try it](https://tomdacatto.github.io/pollinations-postcard-worlds)

highlights.title: Turn study notes into songs
highlights.text: Tunemory makes short songs from facts, formulas, or word lists and checks the lyrics for missing details. [Try it](https://tomdacatto.github.io/pollinations-tunemory)

highlights.title: More tools for MCP clients
highlights.text: Check usage and earnings, browse quests, and manage API keys from your MCP client. [MCP docs](https://gen.pollinations.ai/docs#tag/mcp-servers).

highlights.title: Sandboxes from `polli`
highlights.text: Create, list, and stop sandboxes from the CLI, then generate SSH configuration to connect. [Get the CLI](https://www.npmjs.com/package/@pollinations/cli).

highlights.title: PDFs and audio in chat requests
highlights.text: Send inline PDFs to OpenRouter models or base64 audio to Inkling; Gen handles the media transfer behind the scenes. [API docs](https://gen.pollinations.ai/docs).

highlights.title: Sixteen design decisions from one sentence
highlights.text: Jev Assembler turns a page description into choices for layout, typography, palette, and more. [Try it](https://tomdacatto.github.io/pollinations-jev-assembler)

highlights.title: A little room to compute
highlights.text: Create E2B-compatible sandboxes through the gen API or `polli sandbox`, then connect over SSH. The coding-agent template comes with five agents ready to use. [API Docs](https://gen.pollinations.ai/docs)

highlights.title: The models meet Alice
highlights.text: Compare official and community models on weekly puzzle evals, with past runs and uncertainty shown alongside the scores. [See the rankings](https://model-monitor.pollinations.ai)

highlights.title: A bigger picture fits
highlights.text: Send chat requests up to 100 MiB with inline images; large image, video, and file data URLs can be uploaded and reused across turns. [API Docs](https://gen.pollinations.ai/docs)

highlights.title: A new layer of pollen
highlights.text: Generate and edit images directly in Krita, with results placed on new layers. [View repo](https://github.com/xiaotian1171/pollinations-krita)

highlights.title: A bee enters Unity
highlights.text: Add Pollinations-powered chat, image generation, and speech to Unity games with an async C# package. [View repo](https://github.com/Marcus-Mok-GH/pollinations-unity)

highlights.title: Pi gets a proper plug
highlights.text: Run `polli mcp install pi` to add Pollinations to Pi’s native MCP config without disturbing your other servers. [Polli CLI](https://www.npmjs.com/package/@pollinations/cli)

highlights.title: The garden gets a gathering place
highlights.text: The Community page now shows live project activity, open votes, and Quest rankings in one place. [Visit the community](https://pollinations.ai)

highlights.title: Pollinations in Krita
highlights.text: Generate or edit images inside Krita, size results to your canvas or selection, and keep the original paint layer intact.

highlights.title: An image studio for Figma
highlights.text: Generate and edit images in Figma with your own Pollinations key. [Try it](https://guest453.github.io/pollinations-figma/)

highlights.title: Two new decision models
highlights.text: Try Kev 4B and the free Span-01 Lite through `/alpha/decisions` or [chat completions](https://gen.pollinations.ai/v1/chat/completions).

highlights.title: Bigger media uploads
highlights.text: Send files up to 400 MiB through the existing FormData or raw `/upload` flow. No client changes needed. [Media Store](https://media.pollinations.ai)

highlights.title: Pollen for connecting Polli CLI
highlights.text: Connect with `polli auth login` and claim a one-time 2-Pollen Quest.

highlights.title: GPT-6.1 Sol is here
highlights.text: Use it for text, reasoning, tools, streaming, and image input through the [text API](https://gen.pollinations.ai/v1/chat/completions).

highlights.title: Audio tools in the SDK
highlights.text: Send speech duration, seed, and reference audio, or use `audioTransform()` to change a voice or isolate it. [Get the SDK](https://www.npmjs.com/package/@pollinations/sdk).

highlights.title: A new home for apps
highlights.text: The refreshed [website](https://pollinations.ai) has a searchable app directory with shareable category, platform, and Pollen Pay filters.

highlights.title: Pollinations for Godot 4
highlights.text: Generate text, images, and speech directly from GDScript with a community-made editor addon. [View repo](https://github.com/davealan74/godot-pollinations)

highlights.title: Claude Sonnet 5.5
highlights.text: Use `anthropic/claude-sonnet-5.5` for chats with images, tools, adaptive reasoning, and up to 1M tokens of context. [See available models](https://gen.pollinations.ai/v1/models).

highlights.title: Claude Code, meet Pollinations
highlights.text: The new Anthropic-compatible `/v1/messages` endpoint supports streaming, tools, and thinking across chat-capable models. Point `ANTHROPIC_BASE_URL` at `https://gen.pollinations.ai`.

highlights.title: Lightning Image Turbo
highlights.text: Generate images from a prompt, with up to two reference images for guidance, through the image API. [Explore image models](https://gen.pollinations.ai/image/models).

highlights.title: Audio gets more useful
highlights.text: Transcribe with Gemini 3.5 for word timestamps and speaker labels, or split a recording into two or six stems with ElevenLabs. [Explore the API](https://gen.pollinations.ai/docs).

highlights.title: More voices for speech
highlights.text: `openai/tts-1` and `openai/tts-1-hd` are now available through the existing speech endpoints. [Explore the API](https://gen.pollinations.ai/docs).

highlights.title: Polli CLI grows a third dimension
highlights.text: Generate 3D files from text or images with `polli gen 3d`; the CLI also adds voice changing, audio isolation, and speech timestamps. [Get the CLI](https://www.npmjs.com/package/@pollinations/cli).

highlights.title: Pollinations inside Figma
highlights.text: Generate and edit images on the canvas with a community-built plugin using your own Pollen. [View repo](https://github.com/xiaotian1171/pollinations-figma)

highlights.title: Frugal code-agent routing
highlights.text: Call `community/fadyabohamza-netizen/frugal` to pick a low-cost, healthy model that can handle your context, images, and tools.

highlights.title: Code reviews with Prism
highlights.text: `cesus-agent/prism-code-review-router` matches review requests to fast, balanced, or deep models based on the diff, tool needs, and available budget.

highlights.title: Polli connects to Codex and Claude Code
highlights.text: Use `polli harness codex` or `polli harness claude-code` to route either tool through Pollinations, choose a model, and disconnect without changing your native login.

highlights.title: Prompt agents can call your tools
highlights.text: Give agents client-side functions alongside server-side MCP tools, then send the results back to continue the conversation. [API docs](https://gen.pollinations.ai/docs)

highlights.title: Apps can complete Quests
highlights.text: Submit an app with an open Quest number. If the app is approved, the Quest closes and you can claim its Pollen reward.

highlights.title: Try image2gpt
highlights.text: Prompt `openai/gpt-image-2` from a web app using your Pollinations account and Pollen. [Try it](https://image2gpt.vercel.app)

highlights.title: Generate images in your browser
highlights.text: Simple Image Generator lets you sign in with Pollinations and create images using your Pollen balance. [Try it](https://xzeyrix.github.io/Simple-Image-Generator)

highlights.title: MiniMax H3 Max makes longer videos
highlights.text: Generate 5-, 10-, or 15-second clips up to 1080p, with synchronized audio and options for start/end frames or reference media. [Explore the API](https://gen.pollinations.ai/docs).

highlights.title: Gemini 3.8 finds its voice
highlights.text: Generate WAV or PCM speech in 30 voices, with style instructions, using Flash or Flash Lite through the [audio API](https://gen.pollinations.ai/docs).

highlights.title: GPT-6 Sol and Luna join the lineup
highlights.text: Use both alongside Astra for vision, tools, structured output, streaming, and reasoning. Quest Pollen works too. [See available models](https://gen.pollinations.ai/v1/models).

highlights.title: Polli meets tgpt
highlights.text: Connect tgpt to Pollinations with `polli harness tgpt on`, using `openai/gpt-5.4-nano` by default—and turn it back off without trampling your existing setup. [View repo](https://github.com/pollinations/pollinations)

highlights.title: Qwen Image 2.1 arrives
highlights.text: Generate images or guide edits with up to 10 reference images using `qwen/qwen-image-2.1`. The model has brought its own collage scissors. [Try it](https://pollinations.ai/play)

highlights.title: Recraft V4.1 Flash
highlights.text: Generate crisp text-to-image work with `recraft/recraft-v4.1-flash`, including aspect ratios from square to 9:16. [Check the API Docs](https://gen.pollinations.ai/docs)

highlights.title: What TTS joins the app garden
highlights.text: A browser-based Arabic RTL text-to-speech app with Pollinations OAuth is now in the community catalog. [Try it](https://bloodtubes6-cmyk.github.io/Blood)

highlights.title: Video input for Ling 3.0 Flash VL
highlights.text: Send `video_url` alongside text and images to `inclusionai/ling-3.0-flash-vl`. The hive watches clips now. [API Docs](https://gen.pollinations.ai/docs)

highlights.title: `polli whoami`
highlights.text: Check which Polli identity your CLI is using with one small, script-friendly command: `polli whoami`.

highlights.title: Seven models, same IDs
highlights.text: Fireworks-backed models moved before the shutdown, keeping existing calls alive; Kimi K2.6 can now accept up to 30 images per request.

highlights.title: GATEKEEPER
highlights.text: A 60-second arcade arena where an AI writes each run’s survival rules. Fixed rulebooks were apparently too stable. [Try it](https://khuzaima3232.github.io/gatekeeper)

highlights.title: GPT-5.3 Codex
highlights.text: `openai/gpt-5.3-codex` is now available with a 400K-token context window, tool use, structured output, images, files, reasoning, streaming, and terminal workflows. [Try the API](https://gen.pollinations.ai/docs)

highlights.title: MiMo V2.6 Flash and Pro
highlights.text: Two Xiaomi models join the text API with image input, tools, streaming, JSON schema, reasoning controls, and a frankly excessive 1M-token context window. [Browse models](https://gen.pollinations.ai/v1/models)

highlights.title: New Azure image models
highlights.text: Generate and edit with `microsoft/mai-image-2.6`, its faster Flash sibling, and `black-forest-labs/flux.1.1-pro` through the existing image API. [Try image generation](https://pollinations.ai/play)

highlights.title: Floret gets 3D output
highlights.text: Floret now uses shared authenticated media tools and can produce downloadable 3D generations alongside editable, publishable media.

highlights.title: GPT Image overflow
highlights.text: `gpt-image-2`, Flare, and Sunburst can absorb larger generation bursts through Azure with OpenAI fallback; Flare and Sunburst also cost 25% less.

highlights.title: ShouldIApply
highlights.text: Paste a resume and job description to estimate your odds of clearing the initial screen before beginning the traditional application odyssey. [Try it](https://notsointresting.github.io/shouldiapply)

highlights.title: Claude Opus 5.5
highlights.text: `anthropic/claude-opus-5.5` is available through the unified API: 1M-token context, image input, adaptive thinking, automatic tools, and up to 128K output tokens. [API Docs](https://gen.pollinations.ai/docs)

highlights.title: GPT-6 Sol and Luna
highlights.text: Two new paid OpenAI models, `openai/gpt-6-sol` and `openai/gpt-6-luna`, now work through the existing text API. No new endpoint ritual required. [Browse models](https://gen.pollinations.ai/v1/models)

highlights.title: GLM-5.3 FlashX
highlights.text: `z-ai/glm-5.3-flashx` brings 1M-token context, image input, and up to 131K output tokens to the unified text API, routed directly to Z.AI. [API Docs](https://gen.pollinations.ai/docs)

highlights.title: MCP moves into the workshop
highlights.text: `polli mcp` can discover, install, inspect, and remove Pollinations MCP servers across 13 coding agents—without eating anyone else’s config. [MCP docs](https://gen.pollinations.ai/docs#tag/mcp-servers)

highlights.title: The router checks the weather
highlights.text: Three new callable routing agents choose the cheapest healthy model that fits the job, using live pricing, latency, context, capability, and modality data. [Try the API](https://gen.pollinations.ai/v1/chat/completions)

highlights.title: A Grok joins the garden
highlights.text: `x-ai/grok-4.7` is now available with reasoning, tools, structured output, image input, and a 500K context window. [Browse models](https://gen.pollinations.ai/v1/models)

highlights.title: A garden for generated pixels
highlights.text: Bees Pollination is a simple browser-based prompt-to-image generator connected to your Pollinations account. [Try it](https://halimyassine.github.io/bees-pollination-app)

highlights.title: Atelier Image Studio
highlights.text: Generate and refine images with reference photos, live model selection, and English/简体中文 controls. [Try it](https://image.xt1171.eu.org)

highlights.title: Jev Decisions API
highlights.text: Ask Jev structured questions through `POST /alpha/decisions`—typed requests and native answers, no JSON folded into chat prompts. [API Docs](https://gen.pollinations.ai/docs)

highlights.title: Jev 1.13
highlights.text: `typesafe/jev-1.13` is now the canonical Jev model name, while `jev` and `typesafe/jev` keep working because breaking people’s code is not a feature. [Available models](https://gen.pollinations.ai/v1/models)

highlights.title: Model discovery now includes vitals
highlights.text: `/v1/models` and `/models` return each model’s recent health, success rate, and request volume—so choosing a model involves slightly less divination. [Browse models](https://gen.pollinations.ai/v1/models)

highlights.title: PersonaMorph turns photos into personas
highlights.text: Connect a Pollinations wallet and use image edits to remake portraits as artistic identities. [Try it](https://personamorph-ai-production.up.railway.app)

highlights.title: Oracle Mystique deals three illustrated cards
highlights.text: Ask the AI tarot reader for a Past, Present, and Future spread, with generated card art and BYOP OAuth2. [Try it](https://oracle-mystique.up.railway.app)

highlights.title: Arabic browser-only text-to-speech
highlights.text: An RTL app lets Arabic-speaking makers sign in with BYOP PKCE and generate speech without maintaining a backend. [Try it](https://thinglover21-ux.github.io/My-app-mod)

highlights.title: FLUX.2 Max
highlights.text: High-end image generation and editing now supports up to eight reference images via `black-forest-labs/flux.2-max`. [Try the image API](https://gen.pollinations.ai/image/{prompt})

highlights.title: Tencent HY3 and HY4 Preview
highlights.text: Two large-context text models joined the API: `tencent/hy3` for high-reasoning workloads and `tencent/hy4-preview` with a 1M-token context window. [Browse models](https://gen.pollinations.ai/v1/models)

highlights.title: Typed decisions with Jev
highlights.text: Call `typesafe/jev` (or `jev`) through Chat Completions for structured answers with calibrated confidence, or use `jev_decide` through MCP. [Check the API docs](https://gen.pollinations.ai/docs)

highlights.title: GPT-4o mini
highlights.text: `openai/gpt-4o-mini` is now available through the unified text API, with a 128K context window and pinned provider routing. [Browse models](https://gen.pollinations.ai/v1/models)

highlights.title: Your key has a pulse
highlights.text: Account menus now show live Pollen balances, limits, and key details—and refresh after buying Pollen or changing permissions. [Manage keys](https://enter.pollinations.ai/keys)

highlights.title: Model status, minus the weather report
highlights.text: Check cached model uptime directly with the new `/models/status` endpoint. [API Docs](https://gen.pollinations.ai/docs)

highlights.title: DCORE joins the garden
highlights.text: Generate Pollinations images from a Discord–Telegram bot already tending 16 servers. [Try it](https://bot.dtempest.online)

highlights.title: A small pile of developer shortcuts
highlights.text: New community tools turn plain English into regexes, SQL, API blueprints, converted code, or unit tests. [Try it](https://fadyabohamza-netizen.github.io/regexly) [Try it](https://fadyabohamza-netizen.github.io/sqlcraft) [Try it](https://fadyabohamza-netizen.github.io/apiscribe) [Try it](https://fadyabohamza-netizen.github.io/codeverter) [Try it](https://fadyabohamza-netizen.github.io/testmine)

highlights.title: ElevenLabs Music v2.5
highlights.text: Generate and inpaint music with the newer `elevenlabs/music-v2.5` model through the audio API. [API Docs](https://gen.pollinations.ai/docs)

highlights.title: CatGPT Has Opinions
highlights.text: Call `Creatneworld/catgpt-comic` through chat to get a sarcastic cat answer and an inline single-panel comic in one Markdown response.

highlights.title: The bees remember now
highlights.text: Computer MCP agents can now share Git-backed collective memory—read, commit, and build on notes without handing shell access any credentials. [MCP Servers](https://gen.pollinations.ai/docs#tag/mcp-servers)

highlights.title: A fox remembers
highlights.text: Chat with Moko, a desert-fox NPC that keeps the facts you ask it to remember between conversations. [Try it](https://heard-was-lessons-altered.trycloudflare.com)

highlights.title: A catalog with a pulse
highlights.text: Filter model catalogs by `source=official|community` and opt into healthy models with `reliability=reliable`; responses now include compact 24-hour health data. [Browse models](https://gen.pollinations.ai/v1/models)

highlights.title: Routes learn to self-report
highlights.text: Inspect primary and fallback model routes, rescue counts, and per-attempt upstream latency through the new `/v1/models/status/routes` endpoint. [Check the API docs](https://gen.pollinations.ai/docs)

highlights.title: Scout finds the trail
highlights.text: `meta/llama-4-scout` is back: text, vision, streaming, up to 10 images, and 16,384 output tokens, with primary and fallback routes behind it. [Try it](https://pollinations.ai/play)

highlights.title: Pick the best bloom
highlights.text: PollenBatch generates quick low-res image variations before high-res regeneration, with a character engine for keeping recurring faces less mysteriously mutable. [Try it](https://donwrightdesigns.github.io/pollenbatch)

highlights.title: The hive speaks LLM
highlights.text: Install `llm-pollinations` to use Pollinations chat models in LLM’s CLI and Python—streaming, vision, tool calls, reasoning, and multi-turn chat included. [View repo](https://github.com/pollinations/pollinations)

highlights.title: Agents, meet the quest garden
highlights.text: Use a qualifying agent to earn 0.25 Pollen, or create an agent somebody uses to earn 2 Pollen. The bees have started keeping score.

highlights.title: Media stays in the garden
highlights.text: Apps using the shared UI can now render generated images, audio, and video inline in Markdown, alongside readable code blocks with one-click copy.

highlights.title: Follow the contract vines
highlights.text: Explore an EVM contract’s The Graph entities and event handlers as an interactive, AI-illustrated ecosystem map. [Try it](https://ceg-wine.vercel.app)

highlights.title: Panels in the pollen
highlights.text: Plan scenes, generate art, add dialogue, and assemble a vertical webtoon in one comic-making workspace. [Try it](https://manhwa-studio-320488177521.asia-southeast1.run.app)

highlights.title: Polli gets two brains
highlights.text: Ask Polli now runs on GPT-5.6 Terra, while write workflows use GPT-6 Astra—specialized routing without changing your existing Gen auth or endpoint setup. [Try it](https://pollinations.ai/play)

highlights.title: Agents declare their senses
highlights.text: Endpoint agents can now publish input and output modalities—including multiple outputs and 3D—through the standard [model listings](https://gen.pollinations.ai/v1/models).

highlights.title: Agent and MCP KPIs land in the dashboard
highlights.text: Inspect weekly requests, unique users, and MCP calls separately, then export the numbers as CSV. Software has begun counting its own pollen. [Open your dashboard](https://enter.pollinations.ai/keys)

highlights.title: Floret knows her toolkit
highlights.text: Floret now clearly identifies herself and can point you toward image editing, voice changes, and background-noise removal when you need them. [Try it](https://pollinations.ai/play)

highlights.title: DeepSeek V4.1 Flash
highlights.text: is now on the unified text API: reasoning, tool use, and a 1M-token context window under `deepseek/deepseek-v4.1-flash`. [Try it](https://pollinations.ai/play)

highlights.title: A computer for every bee
highlights.text: Agents now get a private persistent `/workspace`, Bash, asset publishing, and the ability to push finished work to your own repos via `/mcp/computer`. [MCP docs](https://gen.pollinations.ai/docs#tag/mcp-servers)

highlights.title: 1080p MiniMax video
highlights.text: Generate 5-, 10-, or 15-second 1080p clips with `minimax/minimax-h3-max-turbo`, including first/last-frame image-to-video. [API docs](https://gen.pollinations.ai/docs)

highlights.title: Bring your own backup bees
highlights.text: Send up to four comma-separated models such as `?model=a,b,c` on any generation endpoint; Pollinations tries your fallback chain when a provider gets dramatic. [API docs](https://gen.pollinations.ai/docs)

highlights.title: A friendly chat flower
highlights.text: Pollination_chatbot is a Pollinations-powered chat interface for OpenAI, Mistral, and Gemini models, with Login with Pollinations. [Try it](https://pollinations-chatbot.vercel.app)

highlights.title: Managed Code Agents
highlights.text: Publish commit-pinned TypeScript agents from a public GitHub repo with the dashboard or Polli CLI—models, MCP tools, and AI SDK helpers included. [API Docs](https://gen.pollinations.ai/docs)

highlights.title: Model Parameters, Visible
highlights.text: Every public chat model now declares which request parameters it supports, so your app can inspect the knobs before turning them. [View models](https://gen.pollinations.ai/v1/models)

highlights.title: Polli Visual Studio
highlights.text: Discord communities can request richer page renders with full-page capture while Polli routes tasks to models by complexity.

highlights.title: NewEra AI Agent
highlights.text: Turn a plain-English app idea into a planned, coded, built, and deployed application from chat. [Try it](https://newera.namansoni.in)

highlights.title: StoryCraft AI
highlights.text: Turn an idea into a multi-chapter illustrated storybook, with Pollinations handling the words and scene art. [Try it](https://khushalkks.github.io/pollinations)

highlights.title: Men’s Fashion Pins
highlights.text: Generate polished Pinterest artwork for men’s fashion with `gpt-image-2`. Pocket squares now have an API. [Try it](https://fashionpins4u.blogspot.com/p/mens-fashion-pins.html)

highlights.title: YouTube Transcription AI
highlights.text: Turn YouTube transcripts into structured summaries, English translations, and concept-cover images. [Try it](https://www.mrpaloma.com/trascrivere-video-youtube-pollinations)

highlights.title: Bloom harness for Polli CLI
highlights.text: Connect Bloom CLI to Pollinations text models with `polli harness bloom on`, then inspect or remove the setup without disturbing the rest of your `.env`.

highlights.title: Media joins the chat
highlights.text: Generate images, video, audio, and 3D through OpenAI-compatible `/v1/chat/completions` and `/v1/responses`, with shareable public URLs returned in the reply. [API Docs](https://gen.pollinations.ai/docs)

highlights.title: Vectors join the hive
highlights.text: The JavaScript/TypeScript SDK now has `embeddings()` for text, batches, and multimodal inputs—no hand-rolled `/v1/embeddings` requests required. [SDK](https://www.npmjs.com/package/@pollinations/sdk)

highlights.title: Polli moves into GIMP
highlights.text: Generate images as new GIMP 3 layers, or edit a selection or active layer into a new layer while leaving the original alone. The plugin remembers your private auth after a restart.

highlights.title: Let the models duel
highlights.text: PolliArena runs blind, side-by-side image-model battles so you can find out which model you actually prefer, rather than which one has the loudest name. [Try it](https://polli-arena.cloudbr.eu.org)

highlights.title: GPT Image 2.5 arrives
highlights.text: Paid users can generate and edit with `openai/gpt-image-2.5-flare` and `openai/gpt-image-2.5-sunburst`, including native quality controls and PNG transparency. [Try it](https://pollinations.ai/play)

highlights.title: Generated media gets permanent-ish homes
highlights.text: Images, video, audio, edits, and 3D outputs now return stable Media links instead of accidentally starting another generation when revisited. Old cached creations can be recovered too. [API Docs](https://gen.pollinations.ai/docs)

highlights.title: Activity charts grew little handles
highlights.text: Usage and Earnings now have independent date ranges, filters, CSV exports, and clickable chart bars that drill into the matching table. The Pollen ledger is becoming legible.

highlights.title: More routes around broken things
highlights.text: Expanded fallbacks keep text, embeddings, Veo, and Grok video generation moving when a provider takes an unplanned nap—without changing model IDs or prices.
